summary: Updating a single published CMS item is PATCH /collections/{id}/items/{item_id}/live; the plural /items/live is the bulk endpoint and 404s when given a trailing item id.
reason: Webflow exposes two similarly-named live endpoints. Building the path as collection + '/items/live' + item id produces /items/live/{id}, which does not exist, so every write in a bulk run fails with 404 while the preview path looks healthy. Any hand-written code that writes live items must suffix /live after the item id, not before.
